subject: Manual test kit: Collapsible Markdown Detail
body:
## Setup and open

Wait for active work to finish, then close the SquadDash window for D:\Drive\Source\SquadDash-public normally; do not stop work or other projects. The prepared launcher starts D:\Drive\Source\SquadDash-public\SquadDash\bin\Debug\net10.0-windows\SquadDash.App.exe directly, not the run-slot launcher, reports its exact path and hash, and refuses an existing workspace owner. Do not rebuild or deploy between launches. Open [the prepared launcher folder](app://open-path:tools) in Explorer, open PowerShell, and run:

```text
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Drive\Source\SquadDash-public\tools\Open-DetailReviewBuild.ps1"
```

Wait for the launcher's executable confirmation, then reopen this same durable approval message from Inbox. Select **Developer → Simulation → Reset and open detail fixtures** ONCE. The display-only Inbox message **Detail review: Inbox** and the read-only Plan Visualizer **Detail review: Plan** open automatically. Use only the detail-fixture simulation actions named below. The fixture uses the real global %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquadDash\markdown-detail-state.json and six workspace/fixture-scoped keys; no plan execution or real Inbox/plan edits are involved.

## Observe the untouched views

Do not click a disclosure yet. In **Detail review: Inbox**, observe **Expanded restart probe** and the unlabelled section's default caption **More detail**. Both must be closed: surrounding DETAIL-INBOX-VISIBLE-BEFORE / DETAIL-INBOX-VISIBLE-AFTER text is visible, but DETAIL-INBOX-BODY and DETAIL-INBOX-COLLAPSED are absent. In the Plan Visualizer, left-click empty graph canvas to show the plan summary in the right inspector; repeat for DETAIL-PLAN-VISIBLE-BEFORE / DETAIL-PLAN-VISIBLE-AFTER and the absent DETAIL-PLAN-BODY / DETAIL-PLAN-COLLAPSED. Left-click the **Detail review: Task** card without dragging to show its description in the inspector; repeat for the equivalent DETAIL-TASK tokens. Also hover over that card to read its full description-preview tooltip: both hidden task body tokens must be absent there. Use this tooltip for preview observations below because the compact card text can be clipped. Both sections are initially closed at all three content locations; the visualizer preview agrees with its inspector.
{{approval-check:detail-first-view-collapsed}}

## Copy and find while everything is still collapsed

Open an unsaved Notepad scratch tab. In **Detail review: Inbox**, click the titlebar **Copy message** button and paste into the scratch tab using Ctrl+V. Observe that both visible surrounding tokens remain but neither body-only token is copied. Replace the scratch text after each subsequent copy. In the plan inspector (empty canvas selected), click **Copy details** and paste; repeat with the **Detail review: Task** card selected. At each location its VISIBLE-BEFORE and VISIBLE-AFTER tokens must be present and its BODY and COLLAPSED tokens absent. These are the normal message/inspector copy routes, not a source export.
{{approval-check:detail-copy-exclusion}}

Return to the main window and select **Developer → Simulation → Find in detail fixtures**. This action searches the live Inbox document and both normal inspector documents through their production in-document search paths; it does not search fixture source strings. In the **Detail fixture production search** dialog observe all three rows, Inbox / Plan / Task: each must report visible=1, labelled=0, unlabelled=0. The dialog names every searched token, including a visible positive control for each surface.
{{approval-check:detail-find-exclusion}}

Close the search dialog with OK.

## Toggle, then prepare both restart states

In **Detail review: Inbox**, open **Expanded restart probe** and observe DETAIL-INBOX-BODY appear; close it and observe that body disappear. Open **More detail**, observe DETAIL-INBOX-COLLAPSED appear, then close it and observe it disappear. Surrounding text remains readable in both cases.
{{approval-check:detail-inbox-toggle}}

In the Plan Visualizer, select empty graph canvas and perform the same open/close sequence for both plan-inspector sections, observing DETAIL-PLAN-BODY and DETAIL-PLAN-COLLAPSED appear and disappear respectively. Select **Detail review: Task** and repeat for DETAIL-TASK-BODY and DETAIL-TASK-COLLAPSED. After each task toggle, hover over the task card and observe its full description-preview tooltip agree with the inspector's body visibility. Both plan-level and task-level toggles must work independently without changing surrounding text.
{{approval-check:detail-plan-toggle}}

Now prepare the restart evidence at ALL THREE locations (Inbox, plan inspector, task inspector): leave **Expanded restart probe** OPEN; explicitly open **More detail** and THEN close it, leaving it CLOSED. Do not merely leave an untouched section closed. This saves both true and false preferences. Keep these final states and do not reset or clean up yet.

## Restart once and reopen without resetting

Close the fixture windows and the owning SquadDash main window normally. Open [the prepared launcher folder](app://open-path:tools) if needed, then run the same direct-build command again from PowerShell:

```text
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Drive\Source\SquadDash-public\tools\Open-DetailReviewBuild.ps1"
```

Wait for the launcher's executable confirmation, then reopen this same approval message from Inbox. Select **Developer → Simulation → Reopen detail fixtures**, NOT Reset. This regenerates the same logical message, plan, task, and sections in memory without reseeding preferences. Before clicking any disclosure, inspect the Inbox, the plan inspector via empty canvas, and the task inspector via **Detail review: Task**. At all three, **Expanded restart probe** must still be open with its BODY token visible. Hover over the task card: its full description-preview tooltip must agree.
{{approval-check:detail-expanded-restart}}

Still without toggling, observe **More detail** at all three locations: it must remain closed with its COLLAPSED token absent, including from the task card's full description-preview tooltip. These are the sections you explicitly opened and then closed before the SAME restart, not untouched defaults.
{{approval-check:detail-collapsed-restart}}

## Cleanup

After recording the observations, select **Developer → Simulation → Clean up detail fixtures**. This closes the fixture windows, removes only this simulation session's in-memory content, and removes only the six fixture detail-state keys; real Inbox content, plans, and unrelated detail preferences remain. Close the unsaved Notepad tab without saving. Do not delete the global preference file or use a general simulation reset.

If a check fails, report the failed check and the observed result; do not approve it.
